text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed an appeal from the owner of 307 Rushton Road for front yard parking. Front yard parking at this location is not recommended because it does not meet the requirements of City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 918. Specifically, Code Chapter 918 does not permit the licensing of a front yard parking pad where there is a negative poll result. Therefore, staff do not recommend granting the appeal for front yard parking at 307 Ruston Road.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Did not approve the request for front yard parking at 307 Rushton Road. 2. Required that to prevent unauthorized parking, the owner of 307 Ruston Road restore a section of the paved area to greenspace to the satisfaction of the General Manager, Transportation Services as indicated in Attachment 2 to the report (September 6, 2024) from the Director, Permits and Enforcement, Transportation Services.
